enablementScope: experience autonomy with hard enforcement: (a) self-check duty — the session AI detects its own rework/mistakes and user-behavior proxies without any correction utterance, mints its own event identity and records via experience-recorder; (b) policy-based governance — the owner confirms a sweep POLICY once (policy fence in the ledger file), then the AI executes sweeps autonomously with a full audit journal and restorable entries; (c) Stop hard gate — the session may not end while captured correction signals are undigested or the session self-check acknowledgment is missing; the gate blocks with actionable instructions and fails open after 3 blocks per session (audited). Per-action user confirmation is still required for elevation (L1/L2/L3) and retirement; the recorder never does those.

digestion.dedupKeyValidation: strict 40-char lowercase hex (prevents path injection via crafted index lines); entries without a valid dedupKey are digested by the Digest maintenance command via a legacy content-hash marker (legacy-<sha256(line) first 40 hex>.digested) inside the same state store, so legacy/corrupt rows can no longer stay pending forever
digestion.semantics: maintenance command invoked after a session digests the signals; SessionStart then reminds only about pending (undigested) entries; the recorder auto-digests the source signal on successful record/dismiss
digestion.consumptionForm: auto-record wired (contract enabled-experience-auto-record-v1): capture injects a structured autoRecord route; the session AI judges reusability and calls experience-recorder; record/dismiss both auto-digest the source signal. Elevation/retirement remain explicit and user-confirmed.

recorder.ledgerSource: target .vibe-docs.json experienceGovernance path; fail-closed when missing/unregistered/not contract-whitelisted
recorder.writes: experience ledger fenced block + policy fence + sweep journal (ledger sibling 经验治理-清扫.md) + <dedupKey>.digested marker + dismissals.log + last-govern marker inside the state store

contextInjection.format: claude-code hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext JSON (shared by the zcode adapter)
contextInjection.claude: inject on capture and on session start
contextInjection.zcode: inject on capture and on session start
contextInjection.codex: capture-only (injection semantics not yet evidenced); the standing duty is carried by the project AGENTS.md experience-governance text

source.note: source hooks are never executed; the runner implements its own minimal handlers

SessionStart.behavior: read-only: emit the experience auto-record contract as additionalContext (plus pending undigested count when any). Still zero file writes; silent-safe when the target has no experience infrastructure.

UserPromptSubmit.behavior: conservative correction-signal detection; append one JSON line (with eventId + promptHash) to the whitelisted feedback index; on capture emit the autoRecord additionalContext so the session AI judges and calls experience-recorder without a human prompt; always exit 0

PreToolUse.disabledReason: vibe pre-commit T2/review gates duplicate control-plane acceptance governance (single-source-of-truth); stay disabled

PostToolUse.disabledReason: marker-writing gates duplicate control-plane governance; stay disabled

Stop.behavior: experience self-check hard gate (owner-authorized 2026-09-17, replacing the former 'stop-gate duplicates control-plane governance' disablement): blocks session end when (a) captured correction signals remain undigested, or (b) the session has no self-check acknowledgment yet; instructions are actionable (record/dismiss with --source-dedup-key, or Digest for legacy rows); fails open after 3 blocks per session with an audit log entry; honors the host stop_hook_active flag; the state store is created on demand and any gate error fails open with an audit entry (TEMP fallback when the state store is unusable); read-only except state store
Stop.vibeOrigin: none (package-original enforcement; vibe source stop-gate remains intentionally unported)

idempotency.key: sha256(eventNamespace,eventName,sessionId,prompt) truncated to the first 40 lowercase hex chars (Claude Code UserPromptSubmit payload has no event_id/tool_use_id)

writeWhitelist: docs/项目治理/经验治理-清扫.md

governance.model: policy-based autonomy: owner confirms a sweep policy once (conversational attestation recorded with the policy), AI then sweeps autonomously per policy; every sweep is journaled and restorable
governance.policyFence: ```json vibe-experience-policies (inside the ledger markdown file, outside the canonical ledger fence)
governance.sweepJournal: sibling of the registered ledger: <ledger-dir>/经验治理-清扫.md; full entry JSON + bound events + restore note
governance.elevationAndRetirement: unchanged: per-action user confirmation credentials (receiptId/confirmationHash), never autonomous
